description.value: Arisu Authentic Korean BBQ is a Korean barbecue restaurant in Burnaby's Edmonds neighbourhood, one of two locations operated by Arisu Edmonds Ltd. It specializes in all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ with a minimum of two diners required for the AYCE format, suiting groups of touring cyclists looking for a substantial sit-down meal. The restaurant maintains a gallery of food and interior photos on its website, reflecting a polished dining experience.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 97m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page confirms the Edmonds location at 7328 Edmonds Street, Burnaby, BC V3N 1A8 with phone 604-468-2432, both matching OSM tags. The site is active with two locations (North Road and Edmonds) and references an AYCE table format requiring a minimum of 2 people, indicating a dine-in focused restaurant. No cyclist-specific amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) is present anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business address is in Burnaby, BC per the website.
Website contact page contains a minor typo ('Buranby') for the Edmonds address — likely cosmetic only.
OSM website URL points to the Edmonds menu subpage rather than the main domain root; not a substantive issue but worth noting.
404 error page on the site displays a placeholder phone (+91.33.26789234) and email — template artifact, not real contact info.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with two confirmed locations and a functioning website; no indicators of closure.

wow_evidence: one of two locations operated by Arisu Edmonds Ltd
